visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a white T-shirt and black shorts is seen on the deck of a grey warship. He performs rapid basketball dribbling drills between his legs and around his back. The lighting is bright natural daylight. Large naval artillery barrels are visible in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a grassy field under a clear blue sky. The man continues his intense dribbling in front of a vintage military aircraft with a shark-teeth nose art. Green trees and other military equipment are visible in the distant background. (3) He moves to a location with a green military tank and then to an industrial area with a red forklift. He maintains his basketball control, moving energetically. Text overlays appear at the top, and the sun casts sharp shadows on the ground. (4) In a tropical outdoor setting with palm trees, the man dribbles around two people dressed in large, fluffy polar bear and gorilla costumes. He interacts with them playfully while keeping the ball in motion. (5) The man transitions to the interior of a brightly lit 50 PERCENT retail store. He walks through rows of clothing racks and mannequins dressed in summer attire. The floor is white and reflective, and the store atmosphere is clean and modern. (6) He enters a spacious dressing room hallway with white walls and several wooden doors. He shows off pairs of children's shorts in various colors, holding them up to the camera. He eventually appears wearing a fresh white cooling T-shirt. (7) Carrying two large white 50 PERCENT shopping bags, the man walks out of the store's automatic glass doors onto a sunny street. He smiles at the camera, looking satisfied with his purchase as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-energy electronic pop music with a prominent drum machine beat starts immediately. A male voice speaks with high arousal and a cheerful tone, narrating a story about a dream. The vocal delivery is sharp and synchronized with the rhythmic pace. (2) A sharp "whoosh" sound effect signals a visual transition. The music continues without interruption, while the speaker's intensity remains high. Minor ambient noise and the faint, rhythmic thud of a basketball bouncing on a hard surface are audible behind the voice. (3) Digital "ping" and "pop" sound effects accompany the appearance of text and graphic overlays. The background music maintains a major-key tonality, contributing to a positive atmosphere. (4) As the scene moves to the clothing store, the sound of fabric rustling and plastic bags moving becomes prominent. The speaker's voice is clean, indicating a high-quality studio-style recording. The music volume ducks slightly during spoken explanations. (5) The video concludes with a comedic sound effect—a short digital chime—followed by a final enthusiastic vocal call-to-action. The music swells briefly before fading out, leaving a clean room tone as the speaker finishes.
